d: Jet black hair falls long and straight with long bangs framing a youthful face with a mature expression and sharp, cobalt blue eyes. The slender build is dressed in a short white sleeveless dress with a black bow at the collar, paired with sheer black tights and white flat shoes featuring white ribbons. A long white coat with gold stripes on the cuffs is worn draped over the shoulders like a cape, revealing a deep purple lining. The only accessory is a black tactical assault rifle held in one hand.
